title: How Rockstar's 'GTA VI' release could reshape gaming, streaming and even paid time off
summary_full: "Grand Theft Auto VI" launches Nov. 19 with huge expectations. Its impact could reach creators, streaming, music, workplace time off, food delivery and tourism.
